title: Job Openings at Blythe and Junot Nigeria Limited
content:
Blythe and Junot Nigeria Limited is one of the largest manufacturers & distributors of Hygiene, Personal, Laundry & Dental Care products in Nigeria. As the foremost personal care product manufacturers in Nigeria, our product portfolio covers almost all the hygiene and healthcare essentials for your daily lives. At B&J, our dream is to 'Develop a Healthier Nation'. By manufacturing a wide range of affordable and superior quality products that are suitable for the entire family.

We are  recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Assistant Production Manager

Job Location: Igbesa, Ogun

Requirements
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Candidates should possess relevant qualifications with 5 years experience in similar position in a reputable Detergent Industry.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Control Room Operator

Job Location: Nigeria

Job Summary


	We are seeking a competent and detail-oriented Control Room Operator to monitor and control our detergent manufacturing processes, ensuring safe, efficient, and uninterrupted production.


Key Responsibilities


	Monitor and control production processes from the control room.
	Operate PLC/SCADA systems and monitor process parameters where applicable.
	Ensure production activities meet set targets and quality standards.
	Identify and report process abnormalities, equipment faults, and production deviations.
	Coordinate with field operators, maintenance, and quality control teams.
	Maintain accurate production records and shift handover
	Ensure compliance with safety procedures and standard operating procedures.
	Support troubleshooting and minimise production downtime.


Requirements


	OND, HND, or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, or a related discipline.
	3–5 years of experience in manufacturing, preferably FMCG, detergent production, or chemical processing.
	Experience with automated production systems is an advantage.
	Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
	Ability to work shifts and maintain high safety standards.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Control Room Operator" as the subject of the email.

  "description": "At Strivo Labs, we are passionate about helping businesses scale with speed and precision. We specialise in providing end-to-end digital solutions, from custom design and MVP development to automation and content creation.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Payroll Lending Manager &ndash; Private Sector
Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Role Overview


	We are seeking an experienced Payroll Lending Manager &ndash; Private Sector to drive the growth and performance of the private-sector payroll lending portfolio.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for developing employer partnerships, driving sales and loan origination, managing portfolio performance, and ensuring effective underwriting, remittance, risk management, and compliance.
	This role requires strong business development and relationship management skills, as well as the willingness to travel extensively across Nigeria.


Key Responsibilities
Employer Partnerships, Business Growth &amp; Sales:


	Identify, onboard, and manage relationships with private-sector employers, including corporates and SMEs, to establish salary deduction or check-off partnerships.
	Drive loan origination, disbursement volumes, and portfolio growth in line with approved targets and risk appetite.
	Develop and improve the end-to-end payroll lending sales process, from employer prospecting and partnership development to employee acquisition, conversion, and loan disbursement.
	Own sales execution, ensuring agreed sales activities, pipeline targets, conversion rates, and growth objectives are achieved.
	Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective employer partnerships across target industries and locations.
	Collaborate with Sales, Business Development, Credit, Risk, and other relevant teams to drive business growth.
	Travel extensively across Nigeria to develop employer relationships, pursue business opportunities, support sales activities, and strengthen existing partnerships.


Underwriting &amp; Deduction Management:


	Develop and continuously improve underwriting criteria for private-sector employees, considering employer credit standing, industry risk, employment tenure, income verification, and other relevant credit parameters.
	Work closely with employer HR and payroll teams to verify employment status, salary, deduction consent, and remittance compliance.
	Manage accounts where employees resign, are terminated, or change employers, including transitioning affected accounts from payroll deduction to direct collection where required.
	Risk, Compliance &amp; Portfolio ManagementMonitor employer-level risk indicators, including restructuring, layoffs, delayed salary payments, financial distress, and other factors that may affect repayment performance.
	Take appropriate actions to manage employer exposure and maintain portfolio quality.Own portfolio performance, including PAR and NPL, and drive appropriate remedial and recovery actions on delinquent accounts.
	Work with Legal, Compliance, Credit, and Risk teams to ensure payroll lending activities and employer partnerships comply with regulatory and internal requirements.
	Balance portfolio growth with appropriate credit quality, risk management, and compliance controls.


Reporting &amp; Performance Management:


	Prepare regular reports covering sales pipeline, employer acquisition, loan origination, disbursement volumes, conversion rates, PAR, NPL, employer partnerships, and remittance compliance.
	Track performance against agreed sales, growth, portfolio quality, and operational targets.
	Identify performance gaps and implement appropriate corrective actions.
	Monitor loan approval and disbursement turnaround times and drive improvements against agreed service targets.
	Provide management with insights on sales performance, portfolio trends, emerging risks, and new growth opportunities.


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.6&ndash;10 years of experience in consumer or retail lending, with demonstrable exposure to payroll, public-sector, check-off, or similar lending.
	Proven experience managing a lending portfolio and driving portfolio growth and performance.
	Strong understanding of private-sector payroll/check-off lending and deduction structures.
	Strong credit risk judgement and portfolio analytics skills.
	Experience with loan management systems and reporting tools.
	Experience in fintech, consumer lending, or digital credit operations is highly preferred.
	Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
	Relevant professional certification in credit, risk, banking, finance, or a related discipline is an advantage.CIBN, RIMAN, ICAN, or equivalent certification is an added advantage.
	Experience driving lending growth, portfolio improvement, or operational transformation initiatives is desirable.
	Strong ownership, judgement, resilience, and follow-through.
	Good understanding of regulatory and business environments.
	Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Nigeria.


What We&rsquo;re Looking For:


	The ideal candidate should be commercially driven, relationship-focused, and comfortable managing both business growth and portfolio risk.
	You should be able to build strong employer partnerships, drive lending performance, analyse portfolio trends, and make sound credit and business decisions.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: hiring@strivolabs.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

	Prepare regular reports covering sales pipeline, employer acquisition, loan origination, disbursement volumes, conversion rates, PAR, NPL, employer partnerships, and remittance compliance.
	Track performance against agreed sales, growth, portfolio quality, and operational targets.
	Identify performance gaps and implement appropriate corrective actions.
	Monitor loan approval and disbursement turnaround times and drive improvements against agreed service targets.
	Provide management with insights on sales performance, portfolio trends, emerging risks, and new growth opportunities.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.6–10 years of experience in consumer or retail lending, with demonstrable exposure to payroll, public-sector, check-off, or similar lending.
	Proven experience managing a lending portfolio and driving portfolio growth and performance.
	Strong understanding of private-sector payroll/check-off lending and deduction structures.
	Strong credit risk judgement and portfolio analytics skills.
	Experience with loan management systems and reporting tools.
	Experience in fintech, consumer lending, or digital credit operations is highly preferred.
	Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
	Relevant professional certification in credit, risk, banking, finance, or a related discipline is an advantage.CIBN, RIMAN, ICAN, or equivalent certification is an added advantage.
	Experience driving lending growth, portfolio improvement, or operational transformation initiatives is desirable.
	Strong ownership, judgement, resilience, and follow-through.
	Good understanding of regulatory and business environments.
	Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Nigeria.


What We’re Looking For:


	The ideal candidate should be commercially driven, relationship-focused, and comfortable managing both business growth and portfolio risk.
	You should be able to build strong employer partnerships, drive lending performance, analyse portfolio trends, and make sound credit and business decisions.
